sentences.text: Acynodon possessed an extremely short, broad snout and osteoderms featuring a distinctive double keel.
Articulated postcranial material is preserved in at least two specimens of the only known species, A. adriaticus.
The genus was first described in 1997 and initially placed within the family Alligatoridae.
Histological analysis of a dorsal rib reveals a thickened cortical layer and at least 31 Lines of Arrested Growth (LAGs) despite the specimen being somatically immature.
